mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means there are few, if any, barriers to entry for new companies, and prices are determined by supply and demand."
Perfect competition means there are few, if any, barriers to entry for new companies, and prices are determined by supply and demand.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the points on QE will correspond to a downward -sloping demand curve with various elasticities."
The possibilities are the points on QE will correspond to a downward -sloping demand curve with various elasticities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that society is producing each good at the lowest possible cost per unit."
Production at minimum average cost means that society is producing each good at the lowest possible cost per unit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a "collection of goods with the features"."
A product group is a "collection of goods with the features".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to explain the distinction between substitution and income effects of a price change."
The indifference theory is used to explain the distinction between substitution and income effects of a price change.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the number of firms producing identical goods, which are homogeneous in nature."
Market structure is the number of firms producing identical goods, which are homogeneous in nature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the case with the supplier of a factor."
Same is the case with the supplier of a factor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same as the competitive result."
The Bertrand equilibrium is the same as the competitive result.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that oligopolistic firms perpetually balance the need for competition against the benefits of cooperation."
Interdependence means that oligopolistic firms perpetually balance the need for competition against the benefits of cooperation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount of a commodity produced per unit of resources used."
Productivity of factor is the amount of a commodity produced per unit of resources used.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a market situation in which there is only one buyer of the factors of production."
Monopsony is a market situation in which there is only one buyer of the factors of production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the maximum amount of good X that this consumer can purchase, given their income and the two goods' prices."
I/Px is the maximum amount of good X that this consumer can purchase, given their income and the two goods' prices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the additional utility that is derived when an additional unit of the good is consumed."
Marginal utility is a measure of the additional utility that is derived when an additional unit of the good is consumed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the additional revenue from one additional unit."
Marginal revenue is the additional revenue from one additional unit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the average revenue per unit of a factor of production."
Average revenue product (ARP) is the average revenue per unit of a factor of production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the additional cost from one additional unit."
Marginal cost is the additional cost from one additional unit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the intersection of the two firm's reaction functions."
The equilibrium is the intersection of the two firm's reaction functions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a primary barrier to exit."
Great liquidation costs are a primary barrier to exit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the product of the amount of the good purchased times its price."
Expenditure on a particular good is the product of the amount of the good purchased times its price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the addition made to total revenue by employing an additional unit of a factor."
Marginal revenue product (MRP) is the addition made to total revenue by employing an additional unit of a factor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the addition made to total revenue by employing an additional unit of a factor."
Marginal revenue productivity is the addition made to total revenue by employing an additional unit of a factor.
